caption:
Every unanswered call already has a winner, and it might not be you.

Industry call-tracking research shows 62% of calls to small businesses go unanswered, and 85% of those callers never call back.

The original MIT and Harvard Business Review Lead Response Management Study found leads contacted within five minutes connect at a far higher rate than leads reached even 30 minutes later.

Run your own number before the next call goes to voicemail.

#ServiceBusiness #LeadGeneration #HomeServices #SmallBusinessGrowth #SpeedToLead
rationale: Fills the under-served Third-Party Research category by citing verifiable external findings rather than a generic reframe, then routes the missed-call data into the platform's verified missed-call text-back capability and the free Lead Response Audit.
